title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to appropriations for outside counsel contracts.
text:
[Council File 26-1536]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to appropriations for outside counsel contracts.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
REQUEST the City Administrative Officer (CAO) to identify funding in the amount of $5,687,803 and transfer that amount to Fund No. 100/12, Account No. 009301, Outside Counsel, by way of the First and Second Financial Status Reports:
a. Contract No. 133099; Meyers Nave: $17,803
b. Contract No. 146493; Meyers Nave: $285,000
c. Contract No. 204152; Nathan & Kamionski LLP: $1,500,000
d. Contract No. 201695; Olson Remcho, LLP: $65,000
e. Contract No. 141689; Orbach Huff & Henderson, LLP: $100,000
f. Contract No. 204505; Orbach Huff & Henderson, LLP: $175,000
g. Contract No. 204391; Reily & Jeffery, Inc.: $70,000
h. Contract No. 201259; Ropers Majeski, PC: $1,800,000
i. Contract No. 146534; Sanders Roberts LLP: $15,000
j. Contract No. 146777; Sanders Roberts LLP: $65,000
k. Contract No. 139508; Sanders Roberts LLP: $60,000
l. Contract No. 201449; Sanders Roberts LLP: $250,000
m. Contract No. 145145; Shumaker Loop & Kendrick, LLP: $140,000
n. Contract No. 138910; Stone Busailah, LLP; $325,000
o. Contract No. 146297; Theodora Oringher, PC: $540,000
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the City Attorney. Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
[The City Council may recess to Closed Session, pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1) and (d)(2), to confer with its legal counsel to discuss the need for additional outside counsel funding.]
